source: [softly] And so we reach the Beacon — the end of the first chapter of his dream... [pause] [warmly] and maybe, the beginning of your story with him. [excited] Light the beacon to send him a message... or ask his Oracle anything at all. [whispers] One day, these isles will become a real game. [warmly] Thank you for playing the very first level.
